description: This file contains the implementation of the Weibull distribution as a class extending AbstractRealDistribution, including constructors, density functions, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative probability, and statistical measures like mean and variance.

classes.name: WeibullDistribution
classes.description: Implements the Weibull probability distribution with specified shape and scale parameters, providing methods for probability density, cumulative distribution, inverse cumulative, and statistical properties.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function for a given x.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of the density function at x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative probability up to x.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the cumulative distribution function for probability p.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: calculateNumericalMean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the Weibull distribution based on parameters.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance, computing if needed.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Calculates the variance based on distribution parameters.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the lower support bound is inclusive (true).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the upper support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support is connected (true).
